name: scene_ghost
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Original Oathroll game art, Ledger & Lamplight. Painterly cinematic dark fantasy, rich oil-paint surfaces and bold deliberate brush masses, strong value contrast, readable silhouettes, restrained texture without film grain or tiny noise. Ink #14110F, Soot #221C18, Vellum #EDE3CF, faded ink #8A7F70, vermilion wax #B8322A, gilt #C9A24A, verdigris #3E8E7E; cold sea-blue darkness against one warm candlelight source. Eerie, melancholy, wondrous, never gory. Entirely original designs. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, writing, typographic runes, logos or watermarks; any ledger pages are completely blank and wax seals bear only a plain abstract circle.
Asset type: narrative beat 2, landscape 16:9 highest available resolution ideally 3840x2160. Upper bell chamber of the same drowned medieval belfry, enormous bronze bell overhead to right, open pointed stone arches show moonlit sea. The drowned bell-ringer's ghost stands centre-right beneath the bell: an elderly human in a plain weathered bell-ringer's coat, translucent sea-glass verdigris silhouette, sad gentle face, one open hand raised in solemn warning. Eerie and mournful, not horror, no skulls, no wounds. Thick old bell rope beside the ghost. Wren seen from behind small at lower left, soot hood, short muted vermilion scarf, leather satchel, holding a single candle lantern that casts warm amber light across the wet stone floor. Ghost is luminous by translucency and reflected moonlight, no extra warm light. Clear bell and ghost silhouettes. Left upper quadrant dark and quiet.
